name: tuckit
description: Use tuckit as your project's single source of truth: domain knowledge, board-freshness hooks, and a design->execute->verify->ship workflow that writes every artifact to the board instead of to docs/. A replacement for Superpowers' planning skills, not a companion to them.

interface.shortDescription: Keep tuckit as your project's single source of truth.
interface.longDescription: Orients the agent on tuckit at session start (read state via get_project_state, not git) and reminds it, as each request arrives, that work goes on the board before it goes in the code.
defaultPrompt: Set up this project with tuckit.
What should we work on next?
Design the next Slice with me.
